title: Add wave function to public API exports in agile/__init__.py
body:
Update orgos/agile/__init__.py to export wave from the wave module, so users can do 'from orgos.agile import wave'. Update test import if needed.

Files: orgos/agile/__init__.py, tests/agile/test_wave.py

Done: wave is importable from package top level.

votes.justification: Adding a single import line to __init__.py is trivial and follows established patterns. No test changes needed unless there's already a test for wave imports.
Minimal change: one export line in __init__.py and possibly a test import update. Low risk of breakage since wave module already exists; quick to verify with existing tests.

This is a trivial change that only adds an export line to __init__.py and possibly updates a test import. There are no new dependencies or secrets, and the diff is minimal, so security risk is negligible.
